case_notes.ipd_scale: x0.5 / x1 / x2 on Grun (1985); EXTRAPOLATION of the model's stated factor-2 accuracy
case_notes.kb_scale: x1/3 / x1 / x3 on the SDC peak density; Doner et al. (2024) report fluxes above models to 55-60 AU
case_notes.kb_alpha: cumulative mass index of the Kuiper-belt collisional dust above the SDC threshold; 0.83 = Dohnanyi (1969) cascade (EXTRAPOLATION: SDC does not measure grains above ~10 um)
case_notes.isd_rho: interstellar dust mass density: 1.5e-24 (below Kruger & Strub 2015 1-sigma), 2.1e-24 (Kruger & Strub 2015), 6.2e-24 kg/m3 (Frisch et al. 1999)
case_notes.isd_tail: NONE = no interstellar grain above 1e-13 kg; EXTRAPOLATED = the in-situ distribution extrapolated, taken at its stated upper bound (Landgraf et al. 2000: under 1e-10 m-2 s-1 above 3e-10 kg at Earth); RADAR = the AMOR hyperbolic-meteor flux 2e-9 m-2 s-1 above 3e-10 kg (Baggaley 1999/2000; disputed by later radar surveys)
